cohort: Pregnant women aged 18-45 with confirmed viral hepatitis (HBV, HCV, HDV, HEV) who delivered at a tertiary care center between January 2021 and December 2023.
finding: Pregnant women with HBV, HCV, and HEV infections, when appropriately managed, showed similar pregnancy and neonatal outcomes, with higher BMI and hypertension identified as key predictors of adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed no significant differences across the HBV, HCV, and HEV groups.
